mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE NVL(REQTIME, '00000000000000') <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RESULT = '0' AND KIND = 'T' AND BATCHFLAG = 0 AND IMAGE_URL IS NULL AND SENTTIME IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET IMAGE_URL = '${group_no}', RESULT = '1' WHERE NVL(REQTIME, '00000000000000') <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RESULT = '0' AND KIND = 'T' AND BATCHFLAG = 0 AND IMAGE_URL IS NULL AND SENTTIME IS NULL AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQNO) AS SEQNO, BIZTYPE AS BIZTYPE, MSG AS MSG, MSG AS MSG, CASE WHEN CALLPHONE LIKE '82%' THEN CALLPHONE WHEN CALLPHONE LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(CALLPHONE, 2) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(CALLPHONE, 2) END AS CALLPHONE, TRIM(REQPHONE) AS REQPHONE, SUBJECT AS SUBJECT, CASE WHEN RESEND NOT IN('Y','R') THEN '' WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) >= 90 THEN 'L' ELSE 'S' END AS SMSKIND, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INTIME, TRIM( JSON_QUERY( ATTACHMENT, '$.button[0]' RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000) ) ) AS BUTTON1, TRIM( JSON_QUERY( ATTACHMENT, '$.button[1]' RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000) ) ) AS BUTTON2, TRIM( JSON_QUERY( ATTACHMENT, '$.button[2]' RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000) ) ) AS BUTTON3, TRIM( JSON_QUERY( ATTACHMENT, '$.button[3]' RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000) ) ) AS BUTTON4, TRIM( JSON_QUERY( ATTACHMENT, '$.button[4]' RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000) ) ) AS BUTTON5, TEMPLATECODE AS TEMPLATECODE, '1' AS p_invoice, YELLOWID_KEY AS YELLOWID_KEY, NVL(TRIM(REQTIME), '00000000000000') AS REQTIME FROM ${msg_table} WHERE RESULT = '1' AND IMAGE_URL = '${group_no}' AND KIND = '${msg_type}'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET RESULT = 'Y', SENTTIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE IMAGE_URL = '${group_no}' AND KIND = '${msg_type}'
UPDATE ${msg_table} SET RESULT = '0', BATCHFLAG = 0, SENTTIME = NULL, IMAGE_URL = NULL WHERE IMAGE_URL = '${group_no}' AND KIND = '${msg_type}'

UPDATE ${msg_table} SET RESULT = '${status}', ERRCODE = '${msg_err_code}', BATCHFLAG = '1', RECVTIME = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('${sndg_cpee_dt}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), RESEND = '${resend}', KAKAOERRCODE = '${kakaoErr}', SENTMEDIA = '${sentMedia}', MEDIATYPE = '${telecom}' WHERE SEQNO = ${msgid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEQNO = ${msgid}
